payout_value_note: $50 Visa Reward Card per qualifying referral; maximum 10 referrals ($500) per calendar year
numeric_basis: payout from official terms ($50-$50 per referral); time: referral share est. 5-15 min active
steps: Referrer registers for the program and shares the offer. Referred person registers via the referral link, becomes a member, and completes one of the two qualifying activities within 90 days of joining.
catches: Referrer must register for the program and share the offer with friends, family, or coworkers; members must be in good standing. Friend must register via the referral link, become a member ($5 Savings/Share minimum for membership), and complete one qualifying activity within 90 days of joining: recurring direct deposit of $250+ per deposit into a new First Florida checking account, or a new First Florida loan (excludes loans already financed at First Florida). Only one referrer may receive a reward per referred person. Visa Reward Cards subject to terms delivered with the card.

timing: Visa Reward Cards issued after all conditions are met; allow 4-6 weeks after completion of all requirements for delivery.
